title: W021.5 Source Acquisition Register — Resumption R1
retrievalMethod: Web discovery plus repository connector review. A discovered page is not equivalent to a downloaded, hashed source artifact.

rules.hashPolicy: SHA-256 must be computed over exact downloaded bytes; never use a Git blob SHA as a file SHA-256.
rules.authorityPolicy: Government sources are primary only for the specific subject they publish. Community GIS is candidate/secondary data until reconciled to primary source.
rules.missingDataPolicy: Missing values remain NULL/UNKNOWN; no fabricated election result, geometry, PIN crosswalk, or financial disclosure.

sources.subject: Statutory Assembly/Parliamentary constituency descriptions and schedules
sources.version: Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies Order, 2008
sources.scope: 2008 delimitation schedules; document itself notes exceptions including deferred states and Jharkhand legal-effect treatment
limitations: Digital ECI publication does not satisfy the separate physical Gazette authenticity and notarized transcription gates.
sources.plannedUse: Cross-check canonical constituency names, statutory numbers, reservations, extents and effective regimes.

sources.subject: General election and state assembly statistical reports / Form 20 links
sources.format: HTML index linking PDFs and election-year resources
sources.scope: National parliamentary reports and state assembly results across multiple election years
limitations: Each target state/election report must be individually downloaded, hashed, parsed and reconciled; index presence does not prove every target record is available in machine-readable form.
sources.plannedUse: Backfill only source-backed historical results and record exact election year/type.

sources.subject: Candidate nomination and sworn affidavit documents
sources.scope: Candidate nominations and affidavits published through the ECI ENCORE affidavit portal from 2019 onward, as described by ECI
limitations: Candidate-level documents must be individually captured and linked; portal existence does not prove bulk-download availability or completeness of older records.
sources.plannedUse: Source-backed financial disclosure ingestion; do not infer a missing amount as zero.

sources.subject: Census 2011 Primary Census Abstract state/district aggregates
sources.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
sources.scope: Population indicators at India/state/district level; broader PCA catalogue also includes subdistrict, town, village and ward levels
limitations: These administrative-level aggregates are not automatically constituency-level values. Any spatial allocation would be DERIVED/ESTIMATE and must not be labelled official AC population.
sources.plannedUse: Use exact published administrative-level aggregates and document crosswalk/aggregation limits.

sources.subject: Official administrative boundary database
sources.scope: State, district, subdistrict and village administrative boundaries
limitations: Administrative boundaries do not substitute for statutory Assembly constituency boundaries or India Post delivery-beat polygons.
sources.plannedUse: Reference administrative geography only after checking product version, metadata, terms and exact hashes.

sources.subject: Survey of India vector data catalogue
sources.scope: Catalogue describes available state/UT, district, subdistrict and village vector boundaries
limitations: Catalogue metadata is not itself the boundary data file.
sources.plannedUse: Identify appropriate administrative boundary products and verify state/UT coverage.

sources.subject: India assembly constituency polygons
sources.licenseClaim: DataMeet repository states CC BY 4.0 unless a dataset specifies otherwise; dataset-specific README/license must be verified before redistribution.
limitations: Community-maintained, not authoritative merely by hosting; must inspect attribute schema, vintage, topology, duplicate IDs, seat counts and per-state temporal applicability. Do not treat as official until reconciled.
sources.plannedUse: Candidate geometry source for forensic comparison only; not accepted directly as statutory truth.

sources.subject: Postal PIN code metadata and delivery beat polygons
sources.scope: Postal PIN lookup / office metadata discovery
limitations: No public authoritative national vector polygon dataset for delivery beats was located in the sources checked. PIN centroids or post-office points are not delivery-beat polygons.
sources.plannedUse: Search further for official downloadable data or obtain written data release; keep EB-03 and EB-04 open until genuine polygon data is obtained.

sources.subject: Assembly election portal geometry for selected 2026 elections
sources.publisher: Election Commission of India results portal; discovery via third-party extraction repository
sources.format: JavaScript-wrapped GeoJSON by state election portal
sources.scope: Repository documents five state/UT files for Assam, Puducherry, Kerala, Tamil Nadu and West Bengal for the May 2026 election context
limitations: Election-cycle-specific geometry is not a universal 31-state current boundary release and must be checked for temporal/statutory applicability.
sources.plannedUse: Investigate portal-native geometry and provenance for the covered jurisdictions only.

unresolvedGates.reason: Physical sealed Gazette inspection/custody evidence not digitally substitutable.
Independent physical-gazette transcription fidelity audit not available online.
Authoritative national India Post delivery-beat polygons not located.
Cannot prove polygon containment without EB-03 geometry.
Need state CEO polling-station address/PIN datasets and verified electoral crosswalk.
